card.name: Warming, chilling and handling instructions
card.fires_on: Small words or verbs in administration instructions that come right before how a product is prepared or taken, such as warming a solution by hand, leaving syringes at room temperature, or chilling before use.

modes.label: Warming or chilling
modes.description: Word after a warming or temperature-adjusting instruction, such as 'by' after 'Warm the solution' or 'chilled' after 'enhanced if'.
modes.example: Warm the suspension<< by>> holding the bottle in the hand for one

modes.label: Ways to take it
modes.description: 'be' after 'may' or 'can' in how-to-take statements for tablets and capsules.
modes.example: Paliperidone extended-release tablets can<< be>> taken with or without food.

card.writes: It pushes toward words about temperature and thawing (low temperature, frozen, thaw) and ways of doing something.
card.plain: It marks spots in dosing directions where the text is about to say how to warm, chill or otherwise prepare or take the product.
